text: Getting ready for the puja
Wash the vehicle clean and park it in a safe place.
Decorate the vehicle with a flower garland.
Keep turmeric, kumkuma, sandal paste, akshatalu, flowers, lemons, a coconut, fruit and camphor ready.
Prayer to Ganapati
Remember Ganapati and pray that the puja is completed without obstacles.
Sankalpam
Take a few akshatalu and a little water in your right hand.
Resolve that you are performing vahana puja, wishing that every journey in the vehicle is safe and free of obstacles.
When the sankalpam is done, release the akshatalu and water into a plate.
Sandal paste, kumkuma and flowers
Put dots of sandal paste, turmeric and kumkuma on a suitable spot on the vehicle.
Offer flowers and akshatalu to the vehicle.
Incense and lamp
Show incense and the lamp before the vehicle.
Naivedyam
Place fruit and a coconut in a plate.
Remembering the Devi, offer the naivedyam.
Neerajanam — harathi
Offer harathi to the vehicle with camphor or the harathi lamp.
When the harathi is done, bow.
Coconut and lemons
Break the coconut as your family's custom goes.
If your family places lemons under the vehicle, you may do so as your family does.
Driving over them, though, is not necessary.
Clear away all coconut pieces, lemons and other puja items before you move the vehicle.
Pray to the Devi to grant you the good sense to drive carefully and protection on every journey.
